title: Universal Display Corporation Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: EWING, N.J.–(BUSINESS WIRE)– Universal Display Corporation (Nasdaq: OLED), a global leader in energy-efficient OLED technologies and materials, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
EWING, N.J.–(BUSINESS WIRE)–


[Universal Display Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Foled.com%2F&esheet=54630524&newsitemid=20261028614851&lan=en-US&anchor=Universal+Display+Corporation&index=1&md5=1858131a132666992639c53cf881b842) (Nasdaq: OLED), a global leader in energy-efficient OLED technologies and materials, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
